## Research Experience

### Undergraduate Research

Zhejiang University

- Investigated the molecular mechanisms of early liver regeneration, focusing on mTOR-mediated translational regulation following 70% partial hepatectomy in a mouse model.
- Applied Western blotting, polysome profiling, and high-throughput sequencing to examine signaling pathway activation and changes in translational efficiency.
- Identified rapid activation of the mTOR–S6K–RPS6 signaling pathway and increased translational efficiency of *Tpt1* without significant changes in its mRNA abundance.
- Investigated the functional role of *Tpt1* in hepatocyte proliferation, demonstrating that its knockdown impaired cell proliferation, colony formation, and cell cycle progression.
